consistency_checks.observations: Inspected full sheet: two high pods, broad red torso, central gray hatch, two arms/barrels, biped and wedge feet preserve recognizable source identity.
Front/rear have comparable overall height and landmark levels by visual review; pod width and leg/foot envelopes vary with view. No calibrated pixel/3D solve; use packet ranges.

Visible front and 3/4 pod faces show four columns by three rows each; two pods, two arms/barrels, two legs/feet. Side occludes the far modules; rear does not repeat launcher arrays. Hidden fastener counts not certified.

Major assemblies remain similar, but panel seams/foot segmentation differ by view; rear torso/pod placeholders are marked, while rear limb armor has unmarked invented detail. No mechanical equivalence certification.
Front/rear arrangement is compatible with bilateral symmetry; original asymmetric landmarks do not establish exact object-right handedness or hidden panel correspondence.
Macro top-heavy identity survives; neutral stance differs from offset original and lower-leg/foot contour is simplified. Useful rough guide only; source 3/4 remains authoritative.
